# zeroword_webhook (Resource)

A webhook endpoint of an Environment.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "zeroword_webhook" "events" {
  environment_id = zeroword_environment.staging.id
  url            = "https://api.example.com/zeroword/webhook"
  event_types    = ["user.created", "user.deleted"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `environment_id` (String) Environment ID (`env_...`).
- `event_types` (Set of String) Subscribed event types, e.g. `user.created`.
- `url` (String) HTTPS endpoint URL.

### Optional

- `status` (String) `active` or `disabled`. Defaults to `active`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Webhook ID.
- `secret` (String, Sensitive) Signing secret. Zeroword returns it only at creation, so it is null after import. Stored in state; protect the state backend.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import zeroword_webhook.events whk_xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx
```
